verdict.rationale: Solo 2 can be driven programmatically through a documented `solo2` CLI (list devices, verified firmware update, admin commands such as LED control) and through standard protocols (FIDO2/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP) usable with generic tools like `fido2-token`. There is no dedicated documented API reference or machine-readable spec, and the older Python Solo CLI fails against current python-fido2 with no firmware release since 2022, which raises maintenance concerns. Missing for 10: documented programmatic API/SDK reference, machine-readable spec or agent-oriented docs (llms.txt/OpenAPI 404), evidence of maintained up-to-date tooling, independent hands-on corroboration of the solo2 CLI.
